questionEn: What fact is the correct conclusion based on the topic “Chemical properties of oxygen”?
questionUz: “Kislorodning kimyoviy xossalari” mavzusiga asoslangan to‘g‘ri xulosa qanday fakt?
choicesEn: Electrically neutral particle consisting of a nucleus and electrons
choicesUz: Yadro va elektronlardan tashkil topgan elektr neytral zarracha
